newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares close on lows in hangover from Friday.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares close on lows in hangover from Friday.

text.p: * NZ shares close on lows after drifting down all day
* Telecom leads market sentiment, on moderate turnover
LAST CHG * NZSE40 cap index -16.63 at 2,459.28
Koekoek said the Dow Jones' fall on Friday had an impact, but falls in New York of that magnitude were not such a big surprise with the Dow trading at these levels.
The NZSE40 Capital Index closed down 16.63 at 2,459.28 on moderate turnover of NZ$45.6 million.
Nigel Scott at brokers BZW said trading was relatively quiet with about a quarter of total turnover crossed pre-opening.
"It is evidence of minimal order flow both domestic and offshore. Most of the losses were in Telecom again, which sold down in quiet trading. The trend has been down for about a week," Scott said.
Telecom shed 12 cents to $7.33 and Fletcher Paper was five cents softer at $3.38. But other leaders held up reasonably well.
Brierley Investments topped turnover with 2.37 million shares traded and the stock fell one cent to $1.36.
Donaghys' spinoff Scott Technology had a firm debut near the top end of expectations at $2.10 on light turnover.
Home appliance manufacturer Fisher and Paykel was off 14 cents at $5.56 after going ex dividend.
